en.quote: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
en.riddle: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him
en.speaker: Job

he.quote: מָֽה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי תְגַדְּלֶנּוּ וְכִי־תָשִׁית אֵלָיו לִבֶּֽךָ
he.speaker: איוב
